nodes.name: season-simulator.service.ts
nodes.summary: Server-side season simulator that turns wheel competition outcomes into apps/G/A/CS, match rating, and Ballon d'Or eligibility.

nodes.name: getCupMatches
nodes.summary: Maps domestic-cup result to match count.

nodes.name: getContinentalMatches
nodes.summary: Maps continental-cup result to match count.

nodes.name: getNationalMatches
nodes.summary: Maps national call-up/tournament result to match count.

nodes.name: getStandingBonus
nodes.summary: Converts league standing into a small rating bonus.

nodes.name: rollCompetitionOutput
nodes.summary: Rolls apps/G/A/CS for one competition using rates, prestige, and RNG.

nodes.name: getOverqualifyPerfScale
nodes.summary: Scales performance when player OVR far exceeds club prestige.

nodes.name: calcRating
nodes.summary: Computes season match rating from position, OVR, luck, and competition stats.

nodes.name: calcTrophyScore
nodes.summary: Scores trophies from standing and cup results for Ballon d'Or.

nodes.name: calcBallonDorEligibility
nodes.summary: Decides Ballon d'Or nomination weight and rank-wheel weights.

nodes.name: calcRankTrophyBonus
nodes.summary: Adds rank-weight bonus from trophy score bands.

nodes.name: getRankWeights
nodes.summary: Returns base Ballon d'Or rank weight distribution.

nodes.name: simulatePlayerSeasonService
nodes.summary: Aggregates league/cup/continental/national stats into a full SimulatedSeasonResult.

nodes.name: useCareerStats.ts
nodes.summary: Client hook owning career player state: club+continental sync, season records, save, start career, next season, and transfer accept.
nodes.languageNotes: Enforces setClubAndContinental so currentClub and currentContinentalCup always update together.

nodes.name: useCareerStats
nodes.summary: Manages career identity, stats timeline, club sync, season advance, save, and transfer accept.

nodes.name: useCareerWheelItems.ts
nodes.summary: Builds weighted career-wheel item lists for each sub-step (standing, cups, national, growth gates, Ballon d'Or) for UI preview.

nodes.name: useCareerWheelItems
nodes.summary: Effect that rebuilds careerWheelItems whenever career sub-step or context changes.

nodes.name: useCompetitionFlow.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates post-spin competition flow: league table, cup journeys, national path, then season simulation and modals.

nodes.name: useCompetitionFlow
nodes.summary: Returns handlers that chain competition spins into Server Actions and season sim.

nodes.name: useDraftDrum.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level draft/career drum orchestrator composing setup, stats, wheel items, competition, and stat-evolution flows with resume and save.
nodes.languageNotes: isProcessing guards double-clicks across animation plus in-flight Server Actions.

nodes.name: useDraftDrum
nodes.summary: Composes career UI flows, resume, background save, and spin orchestration for DraftDrumScreen.

nodes.name: career-wheel-resolver.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves career-wheel sub-step pools and weighted outcomes for spin completion (mirrors preview weights from growth-balance).

nodes.name: getCareerWheelPoolAndValue
nodes.summary: Picks weighted pool for a career sub-step and resolves the spun value via resolveWeightedOutcome.

nodes.name: growth-balance.ts
nodes.summary: Soft-cap and effective growth gate/count/magnitude pools shared by wheel preview and resolver (SoT §§4–6).

nodes.name: getSoftCapFactor
nodes.summary: Returns soft-cap multiplier that shrinks growth as OVR rises.

nodes.name: getEffectiveGrowthBoost
nodes.summary: Applies young growth boost only below the soft-cap OVR band.

nodes.name: applySoftCapToGate
nodes.summary: Rescales yes/no gate weights under soft-cap.

nodes.name: applySoftCapToIncreasePool
nodes.summary: Dampens increase count/magnitude pool weights under soft-cap.

nodes.name: getProgressBand
nodes.summary: Maps career progress into early/mid/late development bands.

nodes.name: getHeadroomBand
nodes.summary: Maps OVR headroom into growth-opportunity bands.

nodes.name: getDevelopmentBaseYes
nodes.summary: Base yes-weight for development increase gate from progress/headroom.

nodes.name: getFormMultiplier
nodes.summary: Multiplies development odds from season form/growth tier.

nodes.name: getEffectiveIncreaseGate
nodes.summary: Computes soft-capped increase yes/no gate for a season.

nodes.name: getEffectiveDecreaseGate
nodes.summary: Computes decrease yes/no gate from tier, progress, and form.

nodes.name: getDecreaseOpportunitySeverity
nodes.summary: Severity score used when blending decrease opportunity into pools.

nodes.name: blendWeightPools
nodes.summary: Linearly blends two weighted outcome pools by ratio.

nodes.name: getEffectiveCountPool
nodes.summary: Builds soft-capped/boosted count pool for stat evolution.

nodes.name: getEffectiveMagnitudePool
nodes.summary: Builds soft-capped/boosted magnitude pool for stat deltas.

nodes.name: getSelectorStatWeight
nodes.summary: Weights which primary stats are favored in the selector wheel.

nodes.name: simulation-helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers for continental qualification, competition weight pools, growth tiers, and domestic/national cup labels.

nodes.name: calculateContinentalQualification
nodes.summary: Maps league standing and cup wins to next-season continental ticket.

nodes.name: getContinentalCupLabel
nodes.summary: Human-readable label for a continental cup type code.

nodes.name: getSeasonCalendarYear
nodes.summary: Derives calendar year from debut age and current age.

nodes.name: getNationalTournamentName
nodes.summary: Picks World Cup / continental tournament name for nationality and year.

nodes.name: getInfluenceProxy
nodes.summary: Influence score from expected apps vs actual apps for wheel weights.

nodes.name: getDomesticCupWeights
nodes.summary: Weighted domestic-cup outcome pool from club threshold and form.

nodes.name: getContinentalCupWeights
nodes.summary: Weighted continental-cup outcome pool from threshold and influence.

nodes.name: getNationalTournamentWeights
nodes.summary: Weighted national-tournament outcome pool.

nodes.name: getNationalCallupWeights
nodes.summary: Weighted national call-up yes/no pool from OVR and national tier.

nodes.name: getSeasonYearString
nodes.summary: Formats season label string from age context.

nodes.name: getStandingWheelPool
nodes.summary: Weighted league-standing pool biased by club fit and influence.

nodes.name: getGrowthTier
nodes.summary: Maps season rating into growth tier for evolution odds.

nodes.name: getIncreaseGateWeight
nodes.summary: Base increase-gate weights by growth tier.

nodes.name: getDecreaseGateWeight
nodes.summary: Base decrease-gate weights by growth tier.

nodes.name: getCountPool
nodes.summary: Base count outcome pool for a growth tier.

nodes.name: getMagnitudePool
nodes.summary: Base magnitude outcome pool for a growth tier.

nodes.name: getMagnitudeTierForDirection
nodes.summary: Picks magnitude tier based on increase vs decrease direction.

nodes.name: getCareerProgress
nodes.summary: Normalized career progress from age, debut, and career length.

nodes.name: getAgeProgressThresholds
nodes.summary: Age-progress thresholds used by growth soft-cap logic.

nodes.name: getGrowthBoost
nodes.summary: Young-player growth boost from progress vs young threshold.

nodes.name: bumpTierUp
nodes.summary: Shifts a growth tier one step stronger for boost blending.

nodes.name: blendPools
nodes.summary: Interpolates two weight pools by blend factor.

nodes.name: getCountPoolBoosted
nodes.summary: Count pool blended upward when young boost applies.

nodes.name: getMagnitudePoolBoosted
nodes.summary: Magnitude pool blended upward when young boost applies.

nodes.name: getDomesticCupName
nodes.summary: Domestic cup display name by league/country.

nodes.name: club-fit.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic player↔club fit: prestige threshold, apps ratio curve, and expected league appearances.

nodes.name: getClubThreshold
nodes.summary: OVR threshold for a club prestige level.

nodes.name: estimateAppsRatio
nodes.summary: Deterministic expected apps ratio from OVR vs club threshold.

nodes.name: estimateExpectedLeagueApps
nodes.summary: Expected league apps from ratio and league size.

nodes.name: season-stat-rates.ts
nodes.summary: Per-appearance goal/assist/clean-sheet rates by position and competition context, plus prestige and clamp helpers.

nodes.name: clamp01
nodes.summary: Clamps a number to [0,1].

nodes.name: ovrT
nodes.summary: Normalizes OVR into a 65→90 rate interpolation factor.

nodes.name: lerp
nodes.summary: Linear interpolation helper.

nodes.name: getPerAppRates
nodes.summary: Position- and context-scaled per-app G/A/CS rates.

nodes.name: applyPrestigeToCsRate
nodes.summary: Adjusts clean-sheet rate by club prestige.

nodes.name: clampCompetitionStats
nodes.summary: Clamps competition apps/G/A/CS to sensible bounds.
